description: This file implements a class `_PROXY_BatchRedisRequests` that integrates with the litellm framework to optimize redis cache access by batching requests and caching in memory. It provides hooks for pre-call processing and cache retrieval, specifically for Redis cache backing, with an emphasis on reducing Redis GET requests during high traffic.

classes.name: _PROXY_BatchRedisRequests
classes.description: A custom logger class that manages caching logic for redis requests and reduces the number of Redis GET requests by batching and in-memory caching.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the class, binds the custom async cache retrieval method if global cache is available.

methods.name: print_verbose( self, print_statement, debug_level: Literal["INFO", "DEBUG"] = "DEBUG" )
methods.description: Prints debug or info level logs based on the debug_level parameter, controlled by verbose_proxy_logger and a verbosity setting.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: str, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook that attempts to fetch cache data from Redis based on user API key and call type, stores it in in-memory cache, and sets namespace metadata.

methods.name: async_get_cache(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve cache data either from in-memory cache or Redis, updating in-memory cache with Redis data if necessary.
